cc:Work.dc:description: The fitted quantity is shock velocity, not isothermal pressure. Residual = Us(model) − Us(input). All selected final shock states are retained; HEL precursor columns are excluded. RMS is at observed particle velocities and can differ from an errors-in-variables latent-coordinate statistic. No P–V branch extrapolation is used.
